description: VN yes/no question transfer: learners omit do-support and leave a bare lexical verb before a question mark. Rule en-vn-yesno-do-support inserts do/does for a closed pronoun-subject + bare verb surface.
fp_risk_note: High risk if generalized. Do-support is only safe on closed pronoun-subject yes/no questions with a terminal question mark and a narrow bare-verb whitelist (like/live/have). Statements, already-aux questions, and declarative WH clauses must stay untouched.

positive.notes: Bare pronoun-subject yes/no question -> insert do-support.
Third-person pronoun with bare 'have' -> insert does-support and keep base verb.
Plural pronoun yes/no question -> insert do-support.

negative.notes: Already has do-support; must stay unchanged.
Wh-question is not the yes/no transfer surface.
Declarative surface without '?'; the rule must not turn statements into questions.
